name: The Alliance Needs Iron Bars!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs Iron Bars!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you have those twenty bars of iron, I don't want to know where you have them hidden!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, well, if it isn't friend. And you pulled through. I guess now I'll have to keep my eye on you. It hurts me to say this, but thanks for your efforts. The Alliance won't forget, and neither will I. Now get out there and bust your hump on whatever else needs collecting.
